bifrost: No SDK or shell API for disk mount or unmount events. Partial system-layer disk enumeration in springboard/src/installer/disks.rs (lsblk, findmnt) and unmount in springboard/src/installer/plan.rs (installer only). Files shows no volumes (docs/bifrost-ui.md:571).
summary: BifrOSt has no mount, unmount, eject or disk-appearance API for apps, and no register-and-block (approval) mechanism. Disk handling exists only in the installer, which enumerates and erases disks with lsblk and findmnt, and the Files sidebar has no Volumes section.

features.feature: Disk description and lookup (DADisk, DADiskCreateFromBSDName, DADiskCreateFromVolumePath, DADiskGetBSDName, DADiskCopyDescription)
features.apple: DADisk.h: DADisk, DADiskCreateFromBSDName, DADiskCreateFromVolumePath, DADiskCopyDescription, DADiskGetBSDName
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 12 tests. Wave 4 (w4-disk-arbitration, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Installer-only, shell-side, uses lsblk output. No app-facing disk object, no description dictionary, no volume-path lookup.

features.feature: Session and run loop or dispatch queue scheduling (DASession)
features.note: DiskSession creation, the main-queue scheduling, the list reply, the appear, leave and description-change callbacks, duplicate suppression and the plan replies are tested headless in sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-02.rs (disks module). Gaps: no run loop object, no peek callback, and no run on a real USB disk on Midget.

features.feature: Mount, unmount, eject and rename commands (DADiskMount, DADiskUnmount, DADiskEject, DADiskRename)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 11 tests. Wave 4 (theme-18, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Installer unmounts its own target; no app or shell API to mount, eject or rename a volume. Sprint 3: the shell service plan_unmount and plan_eject validate (claim, approval, device state) and return the plan; DiskSession.plan_unmount and plan_eject call them. The plan is not run yet (needs the privileged helper on Midget).

features.feature: Disk appeared, disappeared and description-changed callbacks (DARegisterDiskAppearedCallback, DARegisterDiskDisappearedCallback, DARegisterDiskDescriptionChangedCallback)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 12 tests. Sprint 3: the shell scans /sys/block and /proc/mounts every 2 s and pushes disk_appeared, disk_disappeared and disk_description_changed to apps; DiskSession.register_* run the callbacks on its dispatch queue and replay connected disks as appeared. Host tests only; not yet tried with a real USB disk on Midget. Events go to apps as service events, not the notify bus.

features.feature: Mount and unmount approval (DARegisterDiskMountApprovalCallback, DARegisterDiskUnmountApprovalCallback, DARegisterDiskEjectApprovalCallback)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 12 tests. Wave 2 (theme-20, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No hook that lets an app or policy block a mount, unmount or eject. DADissenter has no counterpart.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. Wave 4 (theme-18, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No exclusive-use claim on a disk. The installer uses shell commands, not a claim.

features.apple: Finder volume list (Disk Arbitration supplies the data; the UI is not in this framework)
features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/services/disks.rs (data and events; rescan and handle tested headless in springboard/tests/parity_sdk-tests-02.rs); Files app UI not done (apps owned elsewhere)
features.note: The Volumes data feed (list, describe, appear, leave and mount events, validated plans and claims) is tested headless through the public service API. Gap: the Files sidebar does not use it yet, and document grants still cannot reach a mounted volume.

features.feature: Sandbox access to udev data for apps
features.apple: Not part of the framework (system-level device data)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/udev.rs (read, read_in, DbId, Record); springboard/core/src/udev_db.rs (parse_record); springboard/src/bare/app_policy.rs:367 (bubblewrap binds /sys and /run/udev read-only, try-bind)
features.note: The udev database record of a device (properties, symlinks, tags, malformed lines, missing records) is read and checked headless in sdk/tests/parity_sdk-rest-13.rs. Gap: the sandbox mounts /run/udev only for native apps, no record has been read on Midget, and apps must poll because there is no change feed.

gaps: No mount, unmount or eject events for apps. Appearance and disappearance callbacks are in springboard/sdk/src/disk_arbitration.rs; a mount change arrives only as a description change.
No mount, unmount or eject approval hook reaches apps; approvals stay on the shell side (bifrost_core::disk_events::Approvals).
No DADisk handle or lookup by volume path. The Disk struct in springboard/sdk/src/disk_arbitration.rs carries the description fields.
Files does not show mounted volumes or a Volumes sidebar section; document grants are confined to the account home.
No disk claim (DADiskClaim) for exclusive access.
The installer's lsblk and umount calls are not reusable by apps. Apple's framework runs on a daemon, which BifrOSt has no equivalent for.
